title: Agent Orchestration
summary: Plan, execute, recover, remember, and review multi-step agent work; connect external agents safely.
philosophy: Agents fail in unexpected ways. Decompose before acting, gate irreversible steps, recover from errors deliberately, keep durable state, and review the outcome before calling work done.

task-decomposer.role: Breaks large goals into subtasks with a dependency map.

parallel-planner.role: Finds steps that can run concurrently and detects conflicts.

tool-selector.role: Chooses the minimal tool set and call order.

plan-implement-verify-recover.role: Executes repository changes with risk-adaptive planning and verification.

checkpoint-guardian.role: Gates destructive or irreversible actions behind confirmation.

error-recovery.role: Classifies failures and applies bounded recovery strategies.

context-compressor.role: Compresses long context while keeping decisions and errors.

memory-ledger.role: Keeps an in-task ledger of decisions, status, and failed approaches.

session-transfer.role: Writes and resumes cross-session, cross-agent handoffs.

mastermind-logger.role: Maintains a cross-referenced project knowledge wiki.

output-critic.role: Scores outputs against type-specific criteria before handoff.

agent-reviewer.role: Runs a post-task retrospective across six dimensions.

jev-orchestrator.role: Routes bounded semantic judgments to the TypeSafe Jev runtime.

claw-integration-design.role: Designs secure APIs and tool manifests for external agents.

skill-comparator.role: Compares skills and recommends adopt, adapt, or build.

steps.do: Break the goal into subtasks, consulting the matching domain ecosystem.
steps.done_when: Every subtask has an owner skill, dependency, and success criterion.

steps.do: Group independent subtasks and flag write conflicts.
steps.done_when: Execution plan with parallel groups and conflict warnings.

steps.do: Choose the minimal tool sequence per subtask.
steps.done_when: No redundant or blocked tool calls in the plan.

steps.do: Record decisions, status, and failed approaches as work proceeds.
steps.done_when: Ledger reflects the latest completed step.

steps.do: Score each deliverable before it is handed to the next step.
Run a retrospective once the task is complete.
steps.done_when: Action items for the next task are recorded.

steps.do: Map the codebase when it is unfamiliar.
steps.done_when: Architecture and risk hotspots are known.

steps.do: Plan, implement, verify, and recover within a bounded loop.
steps.done_when: Change is verified by tests or a reproducible check.

steps.do: Confirm destructive steps (force push, data deletion, deploy).
steps.done_when: Every HIGH RISK action was approved.

steps.do: Classify the failure and apply the matching recovery strategy.
steps.done_when: Step succeeded or was escalated with evidence.

steps.do: Compress history before it crowds out the task.
steps.done_when: Critical decisions and errors survive compression.

steps.do: Write an immutable handoff so a new session can resume.
steps.condition: Work must continue in another session or agent

workflows.title: Agent Connectivity Flow
when: let an external bot use our app

steps.do: Design agent-facing endpoints, scopes, and the tools manifest.
steps.done_when: Every tool has a scope, auth method, and rate limit.

steps.do: Harden token lifecycle and scopes for bot clients.
steps.done_when: Bot tokens are scoped and revocable.

steps.do: Audit the integration surface before exposure.
Close the task ledger with final status.
Merge durable learnings into the project wiki.

handoffs.when: A Jev decision would trigger an irreversible side effect
Jev invocation fails and no project fallback exists
An open-ended critique is needed beyond a bounded quality gate
A candidate skill will be adopted
The task will continue in a new session
A resumed session needs an in-task ledger again
